state_reason: PROPOSED (Design approvals-pr-review/v001, SPEC §7). An advisory, head-bound independent reviewer: ONE PrReview@v1 per (PR, head SHA), never merges, labels, approves, pushes or comments on GitHub. House rule A: scheduling is n8n-only -- this PR ships NO systemd timer and NO crontab line. Cutover follows house rules A-C: draft -> dry run (prints the would-review set and the §29 preflight, calls no model) -> shadow 72h -> cutover with a receipt, and any competing schedule is disabled in the same hour. The 5-minute cadence is the design's, not a spend decision: one review per (PR, head) and a $2/day cap bound the work, not the tick.
recommendation: Install as an n8n workflow, shadow first (operator rule: new schedules are n8n, never cron).
